component.name: WyldVeil's Media Editor
component.summary: Video and audio toolkit powered by FFmpeg

description.p: A collection of focused tools for everyday video and audio work: trim and crossfade clips, convert and compress, burn or generate subtitles, make GIFs and WebMs, colour-correct, stabilise, remove silence, normalise loudness, download videos and much more - all running locally with FFmpeg.
Portable downloads for Windows and Linux: unpack anywhere and run, nothing to install.
The mouse wheel scrolls the right way on Linux, and scrolling a page no longer changes drop-downs under the pointer. The Linux packages include their own Python, so nothing else needs installing.
Every tool rebuilt and tested; a Start page; new HDR to SDR, Tracks & Remux, Compare & Quality and Metadata Cleaner tools; FSR, NIS and AI upscaling; automatic collage layouts; a command line.
